research_gaps: No coverage of free, no-auth-required APIs with specific endpoints and rate limits — research mentions tools but not how to programmatically access them
Missing practical information about API sandbox compatibility — which APIs work in restricted environments vs requiring specific network configurations
No coverage of Semantic Scholar API, which is free and provides richer academic metadata than arXiv (citation graphs, paper embeddings, influential citations)
Alternative data section mentions providers (Orbital Insight, Second Measure) but does not discuss free alternatives or open datasets
Missing coverage of financial data APIs: FRED (Federal Reserve Economic Data), SEC EDGAR, OpenFIGI — all free and relevant to trading research
No discussion of data freshness/staleness — how quickly do different data sources update and what are the latency characteristics

apis_verified.name: FinRL
apis_verified.notes: Active repository, well-maintained. NeurIPS 2020 paper. Now includes FinRL-DeepSeek integration. Verified via GitHub.

apis_verified.name: FinBERT
apis_verified.notes: Active on GitHub and Hugging Face. Financial PhraseBank dataset used for training. 87% accuracy claim is consistent with their published results.

apis_verified.name: Microsoft Qlib
apis_verified.notes: Active, trending on GitHub. Now includes RD-Agent for automated R&D. Built-in model zoo with LightGBM, XGBoost, GRU, LSTM, GAT, etc.

apis_verified.name: DeepLOB
apis_verified.notes: Published in IEEE TSP. arXiv paper confirmed (note: actual arxiv ID is 1808.03668, Team 1 cited 1906.04404 which is a different paper). GitHub code available.

apis_verified.name: Temporal Fusion Transformer
apis_verified.notes: Paper confirmed, by Lim et al. Google Research. Multiple versions on arXiv. Widely implemented in pytorch-forecasting and Darts libraries.

apis_verified.name: RavenPack
apis_verified.notes: Active commercial platform. Claims 70%+ of top quant funds use it. Flagship product is RavenPack Edge. Not a free API.

apis_verified.name: Orbital Insight
apis_verified.notes: IMPORTANT: Orbital Insight was acquired by Privateer Space (Steve Wozniak's firm) in May 2024. Website now redirects to Privateer. The reference is historically valid but the company no longer operates independently.

apis_failed_verification.name: Second Measure
apis_failed_verification.issue: Second Measure was acquired by Bloomberg in 2020. The URL may still work but the company operates under Bloomberg now. Team 1's reference is outdated.

apis_failed_verification.name: Orbital Insight (as independent entity)
apis_failed_verification.issue: Acquired by Privateer Space in May 2024. No longer operates as orbitalinsight.com. Domain redirects.

new_research_directions: Research free academic APIs: Semantic Scholar (api.semanticscholar.org), OpenAlex (api.openalex.org), CrossRef (api.crossref.org) — these are the most promising for automated paper discovery
Research free financial data APIs: FRED (fred.stlouisfed.org), SEC EDGAR (efts.sec.gov), Yahoo Finance (unofficial APIs), Alpha Vantage (free tier)
Investigate API access patterns in sandboxed/restricted environments — which APIs require specific User-Agent strings, headers, or authentication
Research web scraping techniques for sources that lack APIs — many of Team 1's referenced tools (Bloomberg terminal, KDB+) are commercial with no programmatic access path
Investigate structured knowledge bases: Wikidata SPARQL for entity relationships between financial concepts, companies, and techniques
Research real-time vs batch data sources — the trading strategies discussed have different latency requirements (HFT microseconds vs factor models daily/monthly)
